_meta.description: Every Sword x Staff technique and charm found in the sources, by class. base_rarity is the rarity the skill is pulled at (it can be ascended up to Immortal). verified=false means only tier D sources name it. null = unknown.

skills.name: Water Shot
skills.effect: Water DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids.
skills.notes: Starting skill; outclassed quickly [S-14].

skills.name: Ice Spike
skills.effect: Water DMG once to all enemies in a 1x5 line in front; 40% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.
skills.notes: Seen in our game ascending Rare -> Epic [R-115].

skills.name: Flame Jet
skills.effect: Fire DMG 3 times to all enemies in a 1x3 line in front.

skills.name: Iron Thorn
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 3; Wind DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of it; 30% base chance to Immobilize for 1 turn.

skills.name: Healing Touch
skills.effect: Heals 1 ally within 5 grids and dispels 1 random ailment or debuff.
skills.notes: Triggers Overhealing at T3+ [S-16].

skills.name: Stonechief Summon
skills.effect: Summons a Stonechief in front of the caster that acts at once; inherits a percentage of caster stats; lasts up to 5 turns. Zero initial CD.
skills.notes: Decoy; falls off late [S-14].

skills.name: Fireball
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 5; Fire DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square around it.

skills.name: Cyclone
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 6; Wind DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids, knocks them airborne and pulls them to the target grid.
skills.notes: Groups enemies for AoE follow-ups.

skills.name: Tempest Sphere
skills.effect: Wind DMG 5 times to 1 enemy 3 to 5 grids away.
skills.notes: 5 hits = 5 chances to trigger on-hit charms (Unstable Aura) [S-04].

skills.name: Void Blessing
skills.effect: Increases HP (ally buff and heal).
skills.notes: Healer builds through T3 [S-04][S-11]; useless solo [S-14].

skills.name: Blazing Fire Ring
skills.effect: Fire DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.
skills.notes: Needs the caster close to enemies.

skills.name: Water Assault
skills.effect: Water DMG once to all enemies in a 3x4 area in front; DMG falls 25% for each further hit on the same target (multi-hits large targets).
skills.notes: Main early AoE [S-04]; still used at T3 [S-12].

skills.name: Wind's Delight
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 6; 7 waves of wind blades at the target grid and random enemies within 1 grid left/right; each wave Wind DMG once within 1 grid of its target; DMG falls 35% per further hit on the same target.
skills.notes: Single-target option up to T3 [S-11]. Sources also spell it 'Wind of Light' / 'Winds of Light' [S-04][S-12].

skills.name: Elemental Mystery
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery.
skills.notes: Seen in our game [R-115].

skills.name: Wind's Whisper
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Wind DMG.

skills.name: Dew's Blessing
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Water DMG.
skills.notes: 'Deuce Blessing' in [S-12].

skills.name: Heart of Flame
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Fire DMG.
skills.notes: Seen in our game as Rare [R-158]. Still in T3 Fire builds [S-12].

skills.name: Unstable Aura
skills.effect: When a Technique deals DMG, 25% chance to trigger Aura: extra Wind DMG once, 60% base chance to knock back 1 grid.
skills.notes: Core T1 damage charm with multi-hit techniques [S-04].

skills.name: Elemental Body
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Elemental RES.

skills.name: Curse Resonance
skills.effect: For each ailment or debuff on the target, the caster's Technique DMG to it rises; stacks up to 3 times.
skills.notes: Pairs with Frozen/Immobilize/Erosion.

skills.name: Insight
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Effect Hit Rate.
skills.notes: Erosion builds [S-04].

skills.name: Tough Soul
skills.effect: Increases the caster's HP.
skills.notes: Healer builds [S-04].

skills.name: Flaming Path
skills.effect: When the caster starts to move in their turn, 30% chance to inflict Burn on grids within 1 grid of the caster.
skills.notes: Do not stack with Raging Wildfire: one burn per tile [S-12].

skills.name: Water to Ice
skills.effect: Fandom text: increases the caster's Water DMG. sxswiki text: 50% chance to trigger Condensation on Water DMG (extra DMG, 30% chance to Freeze).
skills.notes: Sources disagree on the effect; see Open questions.

skills.name: Mana Surge
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Crit Rate.
skills.notes: sxswiki gives 16% + a flat amount [S-04] (unverified). Kept in builds through T3/T4 [S-11][S-16].

skills.name: Gale Shield
skills.effect: At battle start grants a shield based on max HP; when it disappears, Wind DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square around the caster, 100% base chance to knock back 1 grid.
skills.notes: Main T1 survival charm [S-04].

skills.name: Heavy Impact
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid, knocks it airborne (prioritises large targets).

skills.name: Lion Combo
skills.effect: Physical DMG 3 times to 1 enemy within 1 grid.

skills.name: Whirlwind Slash
skills.effect: Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies in a 1-grid square around the caster.

skills.name: Mountain Collapse
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids, knocks airborne, 60% base chance to knock back 1 grid.

skills.name: Wind Blade Slash
skills.effect: Wind DMG once to all enemies in a 1x4 line in front; 50% base chance to knock back 1 grid.

skills.name: Quadrant Slash
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid.

skills.name: Luminous Shield
skills.effect: Raises the caster's Block Rate and Block Efficiency for 3 turns. Zero initial CD.
skills.notes: Still in Knight/Guardian dungeon builds [S-11].

skills.name: Boiling Bloodlust
skills.effect: Increases Crit Rate and Crit DMG.
skills.notes: Worked example: Epic gives 30% Crit Rate, Immortal about 70% [S-03].

skills.name: Phantom Assault
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid, then moves back 3 grids.

skills.name: Gravity Pull
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 7; Wind DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square there and pulls them to the caster.
skills.notes: The pull that answers ranged, evasive enemies [S-03].

skills.name: Diving Gale
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 4; Wind DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square around it.

skills.name: Edge Strike
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid.
skills.notes: Starting skill.

skills.name: Leap Attack
skills.effect: Leaps to an empty space within 3 grids; Physical DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid; 50% base chance to inflict Armor Break 2 for 2 turns.
skills.notes: Combo opener [S-11].

skills.name: Insightful Eye
skills.notes: Kept in the Conqueror (T4) build [S-11]; used as the example for pushing a T1 skill to Immortal [S-03].

skills.name: Counter Blade
skills.effect: Counterattacks (exact text unknown).

skills.name: Blade of Lament
skills.effect: Lifesteal: Legendary 2.44%, then about 2.93% / 3.51% / 4.22% at Mythic / Divine / Immortal.
skills.notes: Legendary per the ascension example [S-03]; a common 200-pull pick [S-04].

skills.name: Iron Fortress
skills.notes: Knight dungeon build [S-11].

skills.name: Block Awareness
skills.effect: Block stat charm (exact text unknown).
skills.notes: Used by Duelist, Knight and Guardian builds [S-11].

skills.name: Pure Protection
skills.effect: Grants a shield that re-triggers on being hit (exact text unknown).

skills.name: Sunset Sword
skills.effect: Physical DMG 5 times to all enemies in a 3x2 area in front.

skills.name: Darkness Descends
skills.effect: Leaps to an empty grid within 5; Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid and dispels 1 random buff (prioritises large targets).

skills.name: Flash Dash
skills.effect: Dashes 5 grids in a line; Physical Doom DMG once to all enemies in a 1x4 area on the path (cannot pass enemies larger than 4 grids).

skills.name: Shattering Sigil
skills.effect: Fire DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid and inflicts Sigil (prioritises large targets).

skills.name: Fire Slash
skills.effect: Fire Doom DMG once to all enemies in a 3x2 area in front.

skills.name: Flame Aura
skills.effect: Grants Flame to the caster and 3 random allies within 3 grids for 2 turns; cannot be dispelled.
skills.notes: Kept in the Conqueror build [S-11].

skills.name: Indomitable Will
skills.effect: On the first lethal hit, survives at 1 HP, enters Indomitable for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled) and heals once.
skills.notes: Kept in the Conqueror build [S-11].

skills.name: Frame of Battles
skills.effect: Reduces DMG taken for every 15% HP lost; stacks up to 5 times; cannot be dispelled.

skills.name: Blazing Clash
skills.effect: Raises DMG dealt for every 4 Techniques used; stacks up to 3 times.

skills.name: Crit Mastery
skills.effect: Increases the caster's Crit DMG.

skills.name: Potential Vitality
skills.effect: Raises healing received for every 15% HP lost; stacks up to 5 times; cannot be dispelled.

skills.name: Ricocheting Shield
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids, then bounces to another random enemy within 3 grids up to 4 times; 30% base chance to Stun 1 turn per hit (large targets can be hit several times).

skills.name: Valor Surge
skills.effect: DMG Boost to all allied characters within 5 grids for 2 turns and dispels 1 random ailment or debuff. Casts once before battle starts.

skills.name: Stunning Strike
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid; 40% base chance to Stun 1 turn.

skills.name: Heart of Challenge
skills.effect: Physical DMG once to all enemies within 3 grids; 85% chance to Taunt 1 turn (100% on non-character units). Casts once at the start of battle.
skills.notes: The Knight taunt.

skills.name: Frostbite Blossom
skills.notes: Fandom's description is a copy of Fire Slash, so the real effect is unknown; the name suggests Water.

skills.name: Guardian Ring
skills.effect: Shield on the caster based on DEF for 2 turns. Zero initial CD.

skills.name: Pursuit of Victory
skills.effect: Raises Resilience Break efficiency of the caster's skills; more Technique DMG to enemies with ailments or debuffs.

skills.name: Rebound
skills.effect: Each time the caster blocks an enemy Technique, Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF.

skills.name: Eye for an Eye
skills.effect: Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, the next Technique attack deals more DMG; stacks up to 10 times.

skills.name: Ripple Impact
skills.effect: When the caster's shield is fully broken, Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids; 100% base chance to inflict 3 stacks of Cold for 2 turns.
skills.notes: Shield-break engine of the Water Knight.

skills.name: Defensive Assault
skills.effect: ATK boost while the caster is shielded.

skills.name: Fiery Star Trail
skills.effect: Fire Doom DMG twice to all enemies within a 3-grid circle around the caster.
skills.notes: Still in T5 Fire builds [S-11].

skills.name: Light of Dawn
skills.effect: Light Doom DMG twice to all enemies in a 1x8 line in front.
skills.notes: In the T3 Light build [S-12].

skills.name: Lightning Chain
skills.effect: Light DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids, then chains to 1 random enemy within 4 grids of the target up to 9 times; each enemy is hit once by the chain.
skills.notes: T3 AoE build [S-11].

skills.name: Energy Burst
skills.effect: The next damaging Technique gains Accuracy and deals 50% more DMG.
skills.notes: Order it directly before the biggest hit.

skills.name: Flickering Stars
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 6; Light DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid and dispels 1 random buff from them.

skills.name: Frosty Nova
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 3; Water DMG once to all enemies in a 1-grid square; 30% base chance to inflict Frozen 1 turn.

skills.name: Void Bubble
skills.effect: First time HP drops below 50% in a battle: shield based on max HP for 2 turns and Dodge for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).
skills.notes: 'Bubble Shield' in [S-12]. Kept in the T3 build [S-11].

skills.name: Raging Wildfire
skills.effect: 20% chance to inflict Burn on grids in range when casting a Fire Technique.
skills.notes: Do not pair with Flaming Path [S-12].

skills.name: Wind's Shadow
skills.effect: After dealing Wind DMG 3 times to an enemy with Techniques: 30% chance of extra Wind DMG once and 50% base chance to delay the target's action by 20%.
skills.notes: 'Wind Shadow' in [S-12].

skills.name: Elemental Harmony
skills.effect: For each element among equipped damaging Techniques, raises the caster's Elemental Mastery; stacks up to 4 times.
skills.notes: Basis of the four-element hybrid build [S-03]; rated S at T3 [S-12].

skills.name: Lightning Mystery
skills.effect: Each time a Technique deals DMG, 30% chance to trigger Thunder Strike: extra Light DMG once.
skills.notes: Light build: scales with hit count [S-03].

skills.name: Treantling Summon
skills.effect: Summons a Treantling behind the caster that acts at once; inherits a percentage of caster stats; cannot be the primary target of attacks or healing; lasts up to 5 turns. Zero initial CD.

skills.name: Shadow Impact
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 3; Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids; if the target carries Erosion, triggers the Erosion effect twice at once.
skills.notes: AoE swap for Shadow of Termination at T3 [S-11].

skills.name: Flame Wolf Summon
skills.effect: Summons 2 Flame Wolves in front that act at once; inherit a percentage of caster stats; cannot be the primary target; last up to 2 turns. Zero initial CD.

skills.name: Dark Bullet
skills.effect: Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids; 50% base chance to inflict Erosion.

skills.name: Radiant Restoration
skills.effect: Heals all allies within 4 grids once.
skills.notes: Core group heal through T3 [S-11].

skills.name: Weakening Hex
skills.effect: Pick a grid within 3; Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids; 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns.

skills.name: Soul Impact
skills.effect: When the caster's summon dies or expires, Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of it.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.effect: When an allied adventurer dies, revives and heals them once and grants Revitalization for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled); once per battle. If several are dead at battle start, revives the one with the highest Power first.
skills.notes: Only revive in the game [S-11].

skills.name: Shadow Erosion
skills.effect: Each time a Technique deals Dark DMG to an enemy, 40% base chance to inflict Erosion.

skills.name: Soul Spark
skills.effect: Raises the ATK of the caster's summons but cuts their duration by 2 turns (at least 1 turn; no effect on summons without a turn limit).
skills.notes: Bad with Flame Wolves (2 turns) [S-04].

skills.name: Healing Mastery
skills.effect: Enhances the caster's healing effects.

skills.name: Lunarwater Threads
skills.effect: Part of the offensive Water (Cold) build.

skills.name: Desperate Protection
skills.effect: Defensive technique used in the T4 support build.

skills.name: Star Shattering Slash
skills.effect: Single-target strike.
skills.notes: Fandom calls it 'Star Shattering Strike'.

skills.name: Holy Redemption
skills.notes: Named as a Paladin Legendary; technique or charm not stated.

skills.name: Divine Wrath
skills.effect: Large AoE damage that prioritises large targets and bosses; main damage of the Light build.

skills.name: Howling Hurricane
skills.effect: Main Wind damage skill; knocks enemies airborne.
skills.notes: Still used at T5 [S-11].

skills.name: Aqua Vortex
skills.effect: Applies Wet, which raises the chance to Freeze.

skills.name: Meteoric Flames
skills.effect: Strong Fire AoE.
skills.notes: Still used at T5 [S-11].

skills.name: Fire Blast
skills.effect: Single-target Fire hit with high base damage for a low cooldown.

skills.name: Radiance Sear
skills.effect: 50% chance to trigger extra Light damage when dealing damage.
skills.notes: 'Radiant Sear' in [S-11]; used in every element's build and still at T5.

skills.name: Rapid Cast
skills.effect: Cuts the cooldown of all Techniques at battle start, so the first Technique comes one turn earlier.

skills.name: Frog Guard
skills.effect: Reduces incoming damage and restores HP when the effect ends; needs Techniques that have cooldowns.

skills.name: Repelling Wind
skills.effect: Pushes enemies away; for PvP and against melee.
skills.notes: May be the source's name for Gale Shield or Unstable Aura.

skills.name: Thunderbolt Mark
skills.notes: Tier unknown; listed in an 'early Sorcerer' build that is not in the Fandom T1/T2 lists.

skills.name: Elemental Power
skills.notes: Tier unknown; same build as Thunderbolt Mark.

skills.name: Abyssal Hand
skills.effect: Dark AoE that applies Erosion; shorter cooldown than Shadow of Termination.

skills.name: Mana Blast
skills.effect: Dark DMG that applies Erosion.

skills.name: Waterling Summon
skills.effect: Summons a Waterling that heals allies; its heals do not trigger Overhealing.
skills.notes: 'Water Link Summon' in [S-16].

skills.name: Shadow of Termination
skills.effect: Dark DMG that triggers every Erosion stack on the target at once; cast it last.

skills.name: Frenzy Totem
skills.effect: Places a totem that buffs allies; the totem has to stay alive.

skills.name: Linked Misfortune
skills.effect: 60% chance to inflict Erosion again when Erosion is applied.

skills.name: Shadow Vengeance
skills.effect: Cheat death: the caster becomes a Shadow for one turn (takes no damage, reduced cooldowns, more damage).

skills.name: Night's Blessing
skills.effect: Strengthens Dark DMG and debuffs.
skills.notes: 'Knight's Blessing' in [S-16].

skills.name: Overhealing
skills.effect: 30% chance for an extra heal on allies within 1 grid of the healed target.
skills.notes: Triggers from Healing Touch, not from Waterling [S-16].

skills.name: Summoner's Frenzy
skills.effect: Raises summon damage and duration.

skills.name: Blade Storm
skills.effect: Conqueror AoE.

skills.name: Flickering Blade
skills.effect: Single-target strike with no cooldown; repeats while the target survives.

skills.name: Piercing Assault
skills.effect: Lets attacks ignore part of enemy DEF.
skills.notes: Persists past T4; the named target for Skill Shard Vouchers on the Duelist line [S-01].

skills.name: Seismic Tide
skills.effect: Offensive Water build.

skills.name: Swirling Blade
skills.effect: Offensive Water build; may be Fandom's 'Aqua Dance Blade'.

skills.name: Light Sword Array
skills.effect: Light Knight attack; Fandom calls it 'Luminous Sword Array'.

skills.name: Raging Maelstrom
skills.effect: Offensive Water build.

skills.name: Iron Will
skills.effect: Reduces damage taken from Taunted enemies.

skills.name: Holy Aegis
skills.effect: Raises DEF and DEF-based shields.

skills.name: Soul Protection
skills.effect: Converts part of HP into a large shield.

skills.name: Wind Blade Spiral
skills.effect: Wind AoE.

skills.name: Formation Breaker
skills.effect: Utility strike that breaks enemy defences.
skills.notes: Used in both T5 builds [S-11].

skills.name: Thunder of Judgment
skills.effect: Light AoE named for the Destroyer.
skills.notes: [S-11] lists a charm 'Thunder Judgment' that may be the same skill.

skills.name: Secret Fire Core Explosion
skills.effect: Fire AoE named for the Destroyer.

skills.name: Radiant Warp
skills.notes: Listed in T5 builds; tier (T4 or T5) not stated.

skills.name: Cyclone Lament
skills.notes: Listed in the T5 Wind build; tier not stated.

skills.name: Ember Flare
skills.notes: Listed in the T5 Fire build; tier not stated.

skills.name: Explosive Spirit
skills.notes: Listed in the T5 Fire build; tier not stated.

skills.name: Fiery Burst
skills.notes: Listed in the T5 Fire build; tier not stated.

skills.name: Chaos Rune
skills.effect: Used in the 4v4 build.
skills.notes: 'Kisha Rune' in [S-16].

skills.name: Rock Rex Summon
skills.effect: Summons a very durable stone summon (Fandom: 'Stone Emperor'); reported to hold 4-5 turns against enemies about 800K CP stronger.
skills.notes: 'Rockrick Summon' in [S-16].

skills.name: Rejuvenating Rain
skills.effect: Group heal of the pure-healer path (Fandom: 'Rain of Revival').

skills.name: Dark Star Burst
skills.effect: Single-target Dark pressure; sets off Erosion through charms.

skills.name: Phantom Light Strategy
skills.effect: Healer-path skill.
skills.notes: Technique or charm not stated.

skills.name: Decoy Clone
skills.effect: Decoy for raids and 4v4; several clones do not stack, so one per party.
skills.notes: Tier (T3 or T4) not stated.

skills.name: Soul Pact Resonance
skills.effect: Damage boost while Rock Rex is alive.

skills.name: Mantra of Blessings
skills.effect: Grants Void Blessing (more HP for teammates) and gives the strongest teammate +21% damage; several casters on one ally do not appear to stack.

skills.name: Chaos Resonance
skills.effect: Damage alternative to Mana Surge.

skills.name: Aberrancy
skills.effect: Survivability in 4v4.

skills.name: Crimson Whirl
skills.effect: Fire AoE build.

skills.name: Storm Rhapsody
skills.effect: Wind AoE build.
